description:
Hushfacebook v0.23.0 targets Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This one has 126 patches and moves to Facebook 587.0.0.39.55. It needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer, so update Manager and grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. Long posts and comments can fold at however many lines you pick, a video you started can keep playing after you leave Facebook, and Facebook's new Repost button can go. Reels can fill a tall screen and watched stories can move to the end of the tray. The location page you used to get after signing in is skipped now, there's a Hushfacebook icon for the home screen and notifications, and the settings speak Thai.

Validation: 5682 runtime tests passed locally. All 1645 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 126 patches applied to Facebook 587.0.0.39.55, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 587.0.0.39.55, build 707414333, or its 32-bit build 707414338. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Added

* New patch, `Fold long text`. Pick how many lines a long post or comment shows before See more, anywhere from 1 to 20. `Fold long posts` is under News feed and `Fold long comments` under Comments and writing. Both start at Facebook's choice, which leaves the fold where Facebook puts it, and while `Show full post text` is on, posts still show whole. (#497)
* `Hide Repost under posts` under News feed and `Hide Repost on reels` under Reels and Watch take Facebook's new Repost button, the two arrows next to Share, off posts and reels. Like, Comment and Share keep their own switches. Both start off. (#450)
* New patch, `Keep playing in the background`. A video you started with a tap keeps its sound after you leave Facebook, through the background player and notification Facebook already has, and the notification can pause it. Swiping the notification away stops it, and so does a call. A video Facebook started by itself, or one you paused before leaving, stays stopped. Its second switch, `Background play button in the window`, adds a headphones button to the picture-in-picture window. Tap it and the window closes while the sound keeps going, even with the first switch off. Both switches start off, under Video and audio. (#455)
* `Full player button by the speaker` under Video and audio moves a feed video's full player button down to the video's bottom corner, where Facebook's speaker button was, and slides the speaker over to make room. Live videos and videos without the speaker keep it up top. It needs `Full player button on feed videos` and starts off. (#431)
* With `Queue reel saves` on, holding Download on a reel asks how many to save, from 10 to 150. That reel goes in the reel queue, then Hushfacebook swipes to each next reel and queues it too, until it has them all or the reels run out. It waits while the queue is paused or full. Hold Download again, or cancel the queue, to stop it early. (#449)
* `Hold a feed photo to react` and `Hold a feed video to react` under News feed open a post's reactions when you hold its photo or its video, the same way holding Like does. Slide to one and let go, or let go and tap one. Their `Reaction` list can pick one reaction instead (Love, Haha and the rest), and then holding a post gives that one right away. Both go ahead of `Long press opens comments`, and with `Hold a feed video for 2x` on, holding a video still plays it fast. If you had the old single switch on, both start on for you. They're part of `Open comments with a gesture` and start off. (#454)
* `Dark box behind folded captions` under Reels and Watch puts the same dark box behind a reel's caption while it's folded, the short one with more at the end. Turn it on along with `Dark box behind open captions` and every caption gets the box. It's off until you turn it on. (#472)
* A switch you turn off in `Switches that are on` now stays in the list, off, until you close it, so a wrong tap is one more tap to undo. The next time you open the list it waits under `Turned off lately` at the bottom, newest first and up to 20 of them, and one tap turns it back on. Turn one on anywhere and it leaves that group. (#470)
* `Fill the screen with reels` under Reels and Watch zooms a reel in a little so it reaches the top and bottom of a tall screen, instead of sitting between black bars. A bit of the sides gets cut off. Only reels where that's a small slice fill, so 4:5 and square posts keep their whole picture. A reel stays filled after you close its comments, too. A landscape video you open full screen fills the same way when the cut is small. Pinch in on a filled reel or video to see all of it, or pinch out to fill it again. It keeps its pinched size until you scroll away from it. It's off until you turn it on. (#453, #456, #466)
* `Hide post cards between reels` under Reels and Watch takes out the carousels of posts Facebook slips in between reels, like "Catch up on conversations" from your groups. It's part of `Clean up Reels` and starts off. (#441)
* `Hide stories you scrolled past` under Stories takes a story out of Home's Stories tray once its tile has been on screen, even if you never opened it. It stays while you're still scrolling and leaves the next time you open Facebook. When that person posts a new story, they're back. Topic tiles like a game or a show work the same way and come back once a new story joins them. It starts off. (#463)
* Tapping the reel queue's notification opens Downloads in Hushfacebook settings, where every reel in the queue has its own row, in the order they'll save. Each row says who posted the reel and whether it's saving, waiting or paused, with its own Pause (or Resume) and Cancel. A paused reel keeps its place while the rest go on, and pausing the one that's saving stops it and puts it back at the front. (#462)
* `Icon style` in Hushfacebook settings has a new `Hushfacebook` look. It draws Hushfacebook's blue H logo as the home screen icon, so your patched copy is easy to tell apart from the official app, and the themed icon on Android 13 and up shows the H too. (#467)
* New `Notification icon` option in Hushfacebook settings. Pick `Hushfacebook` when you patch and Facebook's notifications and status bar icon show the H instead of the "f". Icons that say what a notification is about, like a friend request's, stay. (#467)
* `Use the Hushfacebook logo` sits under `Home header picture` in Appearance and puts Hushfacebook's logo at the top of Home in place of your words or Facebook's logo. `Remove the header picture` takes it off again. (#467)
* The Hush settings now come in Thai, translated by MangaThatsFine. (#436)
* New patch, `Post menu items`. `3-dot menu items to hide` under News feed lists the rows of a post's three-dot menu, like Interested, Not interested, Cast or Report, and the ones you tick stop showing up there, so a thumb can't land on them by accident. The list also picks up any other rows Facebook has shown you. A reel's More sheet follows the same list, so Save, Copy link or Report picked once leave both menus, and the reel's own rows, like Clear mode, join the list the first time a reel shows them. Nothing is hidden until you pick. (#475)
* `Refresh rate` under Appearance, in every build, asks your screen for its highest refresh rate while Facebook is open, or for a fixed rate from 60 up to 144 or 165 Hz. The list only shows the rates your screen has, and your phone's own refresh rate setting still sets the most Facebook gets. It starts at `As Facebook has it`. (#480)
* New `Hide the comment box` under Comments and writing. The Write a comment box at the bottom of a post's comments goes away, so you can read them without it. Off by default. (#479)
* New `Hide badges like Top fan on comments` under Comments and writing takes Top fan, Subscriber and the other badges off commenters' names. The name and the comment stay. It starts off. (#485)
* New `Hide the skip seconds` switch under Reels and Watch, right below `Double tap to skip`. A double tap on the edge of a reel or video still skips, but the +5s or -10s Facebook flashes over it doesn't show. It works on accounts where Facebook turned the skip on by itself too. It starts off. (#476)
* `Hide the full-screen and PiP buttons` under Reels and Watch takes the full-screen arrows and the picture-in-picture button off videos that play in the feed and in search results, like a Live that's already ended. (#478)
* `Ask before following from a post` under News feed and `Ask before following from a reel` under Reels and Watch make a tap on Follow ask first, so a stray tap doesn't follow someone. In a post that's the Follow link next to the poster's name and the Follow button on a shared Page or profile, and on a reel it's the Follow next to the author or a collaborator. Only Continue follows. Unfollow asks too. Both start off. (#477)
* `Reset settings`, next to `Import settings`, turns every switch and choice that `Export settings` saves back to how a new install has them, right away. `Undo the reset` below it puts yours back. Pause, debug logging and the update check stay as they are. (#483)
* `Show every reaction on comments` under Comments and writing brings back the row with Like, Reply and every reaction next to a comment's count, on accounts where Facebook changed it to show only the top reaction. It starts off. (#241)
* New `Hide the Add friend pop-up on shared reels` under Reels and Watch. When someone who isn't your friend sends you a reel, opening it no longer brings up the sheet asking you to add them. It starts off. (#486)
* New `Move seen stories to the end` on the Stories page. Stories you've already watched go after the ones you haven't, so the new ones come first in the tray. A story you're watching keeps its place until you close it. It starts off. (#489)
* `Full length on the seek bar` under Video and audio shows a feed video's whole length at the right end of its seek bar, where the time left was. A 41 second video that reads -0:12 left now reads 0:41 there. It needs `Times on the seek bar` on and starts off. (#487)
* `Thin line seek bar` under Video and audio draws a feed video's seek bar as a thin line right on its bottom edge, like the one on Instagram. There's no dot and no times until you drag it. Live videos get the line too while they can be rewound, and letting go at the far right end takes you back to live. Facebook's speaker and tagged people buttons move up above it. Reels and stories keep their own bars. A double tap to skip on a live feed video now moves it too, where Facebook's player used to drop the jump. It needs `Seek bar on feed videos` on and starts off. (#431)
* `Dark box behind story names` under Stories and `Dark box behind reel names` under Reels and Watch put the dark caption box behind the names in the stories row, on an open story and at the bottom of a reel, so a bright picture doesn't hide them. `Box darkness` picks how dark every box is, from 10 to 100 percent, and `Soft box edges` fades the boxes out at their edges. All of them start off. (#490)
* New patch, `Skip location prompts`. The full-screen page asking you to allow Location Services, the one with Skip and Continue you get after signing in, doesn't show anymore. It's on by default. Turn it off under Privacy when you do want Facebook to ask for your location. (#498)
* **Tooling:** `superpack-unpack.ps1 -Desktop` unpacks Facebook's Android 9+ build on a PC with no phone or emulator attached. (#102)

### Changed

* Hushfacebook now patches Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 and no longer takes 586. On a 64-bit phone download the (arm64-v8a) (240-640dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707414333, and on a 32-bit phone the (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707414338. Facebook didn't put out a 120-640dpi build of 587, so the 240-640dpi one is the 64-bit download now. Update Facebook before you patch.
* You need Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer for the next release. The patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, the one Manager 2.6.0 comes with, and an older Manager won't load them. Update Manager first. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 2.2.0 or newer.
* `Tab bar height` goes up to 130 now. Past 100 the pill gets taller instead of shorter. There's barely any room above the icons, so most of the extra height goes toward the bottom of the screen. (#425)
* `Hide posts with words you choose` and `Hide link posts` work on profiles, Pages, in groups and on the Reels tab too. Group posts go in a group's own feed and in the Groups tab's feed, while search results and a post you open stay as they are. A post or reel with one of your words goes, and so does one whose words send you to a website, like the "Watch More: https://..." drama reels. Words that keep a post keep these too, and a link to Facebook itself doesn't count. (#458)
* `See-through bars` makes its frosted copy of the screen at a quarter of the size, blurs that and stretches it back over the bar. The blur takes out the fine detail anyway, so it looks the same, and phones with a weaker graphics chip have a sixteenth of the pixels to blur on every frame. (#461)
* The Playback speed row that `Playback speed in the post menu` adds now sits on the menu's first page, with Save and Report, so it's one tap away. Before, it was under More options. Turn off `Playback speed on the menu's first page` to put it back there. (#473)
* `Double tap to skip on feed videos` shows how far you jumped, +10s on the right or -10s on the left, over the side you tapped. Keep tapping and it counts up, +20s, +30s, then fades out a moment after the last tap. (#432)
* In Morphe Manager's grouped patch list, `Block promotional notifications` now sits with the ad patches, so the Interface group stays short enough to scan.
* `Hide the Follow and Subscribe links on posts` is two switches now, `Hide the Follow link on posts` and `Hide the Subscribe link on posts` under News feed, so you can keep one and drop the other. The Subscribe one covers the link next to a creator's name on posts and videos. With only the Subscribe one on, a creator's header no longer swaps its Subscribe link for a Follow one. If you had the old switch on, both start on for you, and a settings file saved before the split turns both on too. (#434)
* `Play saved videos in a row` handles the swipe itself now. Before, Facebook's swipe showed a suggested reel for a moment, then the Saved page, before your next saved video came up. Now the video slides off under your finger and the screen stays black until the next saved one opens. Swipe down to go back to the one before. A short or slow drag slides back where it was, and a side swipe is still Facebook's. New `Stay on a saved video when it ends` under it keeps a finished video on screen until you swipe, off by default. (#404)
* With `Search date range` on, the Date posted picker opens on today for both ends, so today's posts are one tap on Apply away. A range you already applied still opens the way you left it. (#279)
* `Cast button on feed videos` also puts its button on a video you've opened in Facebook's full screen player now. It sits in the top right corner, just under Facebook's close button, and Facebook's own player controls stay as they are. (#182)

### Fixed

* `Show the post date on reels` now dates reels where Facebook says why it suggested them, like "Popular near you". In the Reels tab that reason took the whole line under the poster and pushed the date off, so those reels showed no date with the switch on. The date stays on that line now. (#496)
* `Show the post date on reels` also dates reels without sound. A silent reel has no song line, and Facebook's "Reel has no sound" label sat in its place with no date. The date goes in front of that label now, the way it does a song's. (#496)
* With `Keep the progress bar` on, a live video's chat shows up again. On Facebook 586 the switch held back more than the controls' hide timer, so the chat folded into a thin strip at the edge of the screen and only came back with Hushfacebook paused. Now it only stops that timer. (#447)
* With `Keep the progress bar` on, a video's seek bar and buttons stay up in the portrait full-screen viewer too, like on a past live or a reel's details with the panel closed. There they faded about 3 seconds after you tapped. A second tap still hides them.
* A reel on the Reels tab now reaches the bottom of the screen. With the tab bar at the top it started behind the bar but kept the height of the space under it, so the next reel peeked in at the bottom, even more with `Hide the status bar` on. With the tabs at the bottom, `Hide the status bar` and see-through bars left a black band under the reel with the next one showing below it. (#466, #494)
* With `Keep feed position on return` on, opening Facebook fresh loads the feed the way it always does. A cold start was treated like coming back to the feed, so it held an old copy of the feed instead of getting new posts, and now and then Home stayed empty until you scrolled. Coming back to Facebook, or to the feed from another screen, still keeps your place. (#493)
* `Show every reaction on comments` now covers the comments under a post you've opened and the ones shown under posts in your feed. Those rows kept showing only the top reaction even with the switch on, since Facebook picks them in two other places. (#241)
* With `Show every reaction on comments` on, a comment's count shows up to three reaction icons again. Some accounts still got just the top one beside the count, even on the row with Like and Reply. (#241)
* `Loop stories` now replays video stories too. A finished video used to sit on its last frame with a full bar while only photo stories started over, and the replay button on a held story had the same problem. (#380)
* A post you hide from the feed, with Hide post or "Hide all from" someone, stays hidden when you pull down to refresh. It used to come right back. Undo still brings it back. (#444)
* `Report a problem` leaves the "What went wrong?" box empty now, so you can type straight into it. It used to come pre-filled with two questions, and on a phone that box looked done (or wouldn't take typing at all). The questions show in it as a grey hint instead. (#488)
* `Hide the X on posts` takes the X off the Reels row in your feed too, next to its three-dot menu. The menu stays. (#389)
* Morphe Manager now treats a copy made with `Clone install under another package name` as a clone, with the Clone chip on its card. If you changed the copy's package name in that patch's options, type it in again before you repatch, because Manager won't carry the old one over. The app name you picked stays. (#474)
* With `View stories anonymously` and `Hide seen stories` on, a Highlights tile in the Stories tray that you watched all the way through leaves the tray like any other watched story. Highlights don't run on a story's 24 hours, so the check for a newer story never let them go. (#165)
* The black bar that sometimes stuck under the floating tab bar in Marketplace, even while scrolling, goes away by itself now. Marketplace lays its page out again a few times while it loads after a swipe from Home, and the bars used to give up on it until Facebook restarted. They wait a few seconds and try again instead. (#468)
* With `Rounded tab bar` on and a tab bar that doesn't slide away, the space beside the pill shows the page again instead of a white or light grey block, and the Reels tab is black around it. That happened with `Keep the tab bar on screen` on, or on accounts where Facebook keeps the bar in place, because pages there stop above the bar in a different way. (#471)
* With `Keep the progress bar` on, reels you swipe to from a feed video's full-screen player keep the bar at the bottom again. It used to sit on top of the caption there, raised for a tab bar that the player covers. (#469)
* `Hide song and effect credits` takes the song pill with its "Try it" button off the story itself now, under the poster's name. Before, it only emptied the list that opens when you tap that pill, so the pill stayed. Effect credits on that row go too. (#380)
* With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a feed video you open plays by itself again. Every so often one more video slipped in after it, because the first batch Facebook loaded for the viewer came in with the next video already in it. That batch keeps only the video you tapped now. (#457)
* A reel opened from a chat inside Facebook stays on its own with `Open feed videos on their own` on. One more reel used to play after it before the viewer stopped. (#421)
* With `Hide the status bar` on, opening a reel's comments no longer pushes the reel down, and closing them no longer leaves a black band above the Reels header for a moment. The comments bring the status bar back while they're open, and Facebook used to make room for it under them too. (#456)
* Marketplace's home feed holds back the ad rows Facebook started sending from a new kind of request, so `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` catches them again. (#459)
* `Hide For you in search` and `Hide "People you may know" in search` also find those sections when Facebook sends them with nothing Hush could read before. With `Debug logging` on, the report lists the section names each such row carries. (#80)
* With `See-through bars` and `Hold a feed video for 2x` both on, holding a button on the Reels tab works again. Download, Like and More used to speed the reel up instead of doing their own hold, because the Reels tab looked like a feed once its pages ran under the tab bar. (#449)
* With either `Clean up Reels` switch on, the Clean mode button over a clean reel sits higher now, clear of the seek bar. A tap meant for it used to land on the bar and jump the video. (#391)
* With `Keep feed videos muted` on, a video you unmuted goes quiet again when you leave Facebook and come back. The sound used to stay on until Facebook was force stopped or left alone for a long time. A video playing in the background keeps its sound, and turning the phone's screen off and on doesn't count as leaving. (#465)
* With `Hide comment and reaction previews` on, a reel's caption stays put. A few seconds in, Facebook used to swap it for a "Name commented: ..." line. (#464)
* On accounts where Facebook puts the tab bar at the top by itself, the Reels tab no longer leaves a black strip under the tabs once you scroll, when Reels isn't the first tab. The reel runs right up to the tabs, the way it already did with `Put the tab bar at the top` on. (#390)
* With the tab bar at the top, the Reels tab's title, search and profile buttons now sit below the tabs instead of behind them. The reel itself still runs up under the bar. (#390)
* The News feed switches of `Show full post text`, `Translate posts`, `Open comments with a gesture`, `See who shared` and `Photo carousel` show up even when that's the only feed patch you picked. The page used to open only for a set list of patches, and those five weren't on it.
* `Hide Back on opened videos` now also works on a reel or video you open from search results, including the screen with "Find related reels" across its top. Before, the arrow stayed there. That header isn't marked like the Reels tab's, so it's now found by its shape, and the search results page keeps its own Back. (#388)
* `Photo carousel` lets you swipe through every photo a post brought now. Facebook's row stopped at its own limit, 12 for some accounts, so a 76-photo album ended there while tapping into the post showed all 76. (#484)
* Dragging the seek bar on a live video you opened from search results moves the video now, in the reel-style viewer and in full screen. Facebook only seeks a live video once it's marked as behind live, which its full player does while you drag but those viewers never did. Search even opens some lives as if they weren't live at all, and those now land where you let go too. Let go at the far right end and it goes back to live. (#482)
* Tapping a Threads post in your feed opens that post in Threads now, not the Threads home feed. (#385)
* `Local profile counts` changes the numbers on your profile now. Facebook draws a count and its word as two separate pieces, and the switch only looked for them together. (#488)
* `Hide the 2x popups` also hides the "2x speed" chip on feed videos for accounts where Facebook has its own hold for 2x. Holding a video there still plays it at 2x, it just doesn't put the chip over it anymore. (#343)
* With `Tap to play` on, a video you send to the picture-in-picture window with the `Picture-in-picture button` plays there again. The window used to show a frozen picture, and its play and pause did nothing. Leaving Facebook with Home already worked. (#495)
* `Hide Threads cards between reels` and `Hide post cards between reels` keep those cards off the Reels tab again. On 587 the tab loads some of its reels another way, and those went straight onto the screen past every Reels filter, so a Threads card could still show up with the switch on. `Hide sponsored reels`, `Hide AI-detected reels and videos` and `Only reels from accounts I follow` cover that way in now too. (#85, #441)
* With `Debug logging` on, the log stops repeating where the tab bar goes and that a reel runs under the top bars on every layout of the screen. Each shows once when it changes now. In one report those two lines made up nine tenths of the log and pushed out the lines that help.
